prose: OpenAI has introduced Astra for Law, a legal AI foundation that combines GPT-6 Astra with tools, settings, privacy controls and context designed for professional legal work, according to TLDR AI's write-up of the announcement.
highlights: Astra for Law is OpenAI's legal-focused AI offering.
It combines GPT-6 Astra with legal-specific tools, settings and privacy controls.
The product is designed for professional legal work.
